extraction.title: N08b_Technical Plan
problems_discussed: Technical challenges in achieving a solution
teaching_elements: Weekly schedule templates for planning and tracking progress
key_claims: A technical plan should stem from a well-defined problem and include a preliminary design for the solution.
Solution functionality must be understandable to both technical and non-technical audiences and be tested, measured, and validated.

questions:
Technical Plan

Deliverable: Technical Plan
Stems from your well-defined problem (what the purpose of the eventual product or system is, why it is important, and who the target users are), and should include:
Cover slide
What is the well-defined problem you want to solve?
What is the preliminary design for your solution?  What is the technical challenge of achieving the solution?
